PG Comedy | Romance

Wala Kan Ala Albal

In the heart of the enchanting city of Luxor, Hassan finds himself on an unexpected romantic comedy adventure when he takes charge of a multinational tourist group. As he struggles to communicate with them in four different languages, he unexpectedly falls in love with a girl amid the ancient temples. What follows is a series of hilarious situations and surprises that prove the language of the heart is the strongest and most sincere of all, no matter how different our languages may be.

Avengers: Endgame Encore (Re-Release)

The epic conclusion to the Infinity Saga returns to theaters as AVENGERS: ENDGAME ENCORE on September 25, 2026. After devastating events wiped out half the world’s population, the remaining heroes struggle to move forward. Ultimately, they must come together to restore order and harmony in the universe and bring their loved ones back in a dramatic showdown against Thanos.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day (2D)

It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.
